Notes.Text:
This update for rpm fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-44605: heap buffer overflow in NDB database backend due to unchecked 32-bit arithmetic when parsing the slot
  table (bsc#1269584).

Other updates and bugfixes:

- Fix `libelf` handle not being closed, resulting in build errors when using a NFS buildroot (bsc#1240054).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw was found in the RPM Package Manager (RPM). A local user could be affected by a heap buffer overflow vulnerability when processing a specially crafted NDB database file. This issue arises from an error in how RPM handles certain calculations during file parsing, leading to an incorrect memory allocation. An attacker could leverage this to cause a denial of service, making the system unavailable.
